run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the maximum sum of i*arr[i] among all rotations of an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple input arrays and rotation counts to verify correctness
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use Python built-in sum instead of manual accumulation loops
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that finds maximum weighted sum across all array rotations in O(n)
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which calculates the maximum sum of index times value across array rotations
